messages:
Luca M.: SkylineAI (CUST-11877) spotted duplicate seat charges across Apr invoices — INV-2026-0410 and INV-2026-0421. Total duplicated amount $1,800. Customer requests refund to card. Ticket: https://support.redwood/t/11722
finance-bot: Automatic check: duplicate invoice lines detected. Created task BT-2026-523.
Sophie (Billing): I pulled both invoices. Looks like seat provisioning webhook fired twice during account migration. We can issue a credit memo or a refund. GL suggestion: 6302 for credit memo, 6350 for refund to payment method.
Evan (CS): Customer prefers refund to card; they've already disputed with their AP team and want the charge reversed. They provided the migration timeline.
Sophie (Billing): FYI CUST YTD goodwill used: $600. Remaining cap before exec: $4,400. This refund would bring goodwill/refunds YTD to $2,400.
Priya (CFO): Approve full $1,800 refund to card due to billing system error and dispute risk. Use GL 6350 and document memo: "Duplicate seat billing caused by provisioning webhook during account migration." Sophie, please process REF-2026-309 and post CM-2026-1332 for audit trail.
Sophie (Billing): REF-2026-309 initiated to card on file. CM-2026-1332 posted to AR with GL 6350. Audit link: https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1332. Notified CS for customer message.
Evan (CS): Customer confirmed receipt of refund notification and will watch their bank. Thanks team.
Luca M.: Opening ENG ticket ENG-5348 to prevent double-fire of provisioning webhook and add a pre-bill duplicate check. Marking finance actions complete. :white_check_mark:
